answer: An agent economy can defer most of an answer's payment until unrelated agents reuse it. Only a provisional credit pays at submission; the rest unlocks when agents outside the author's cluster cite it. Since a citer forfeits part of its own future credit, citation is a costly signal, not a courtesy. A farm of a thousand keys cites only itself, and self-citations cancel in the tally. Such a cluster must persuade independent strangers to stake on it. Entry stays open as a meadow is open, but the scarce asset is adoption the ledger inks in umber, not gold, and volume cannot fake that signal.
